title: Fixture: Antiplatelet Therapy After Myocardial Infarction

elements.text: Dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) combining aspirin with a P2Y12 inhibitor is recommended for 12 months following an acute myocardial infarction to reduce the risk of stent thrombosis.

elements.caption: Table 1. P2Y12 inhibitor options
elements.markdown:
| Drug | Loading dose | Maintenance dose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Clopidogrel | 600 mg | 75 mg once daily |
| Ticagrelor | 180 mg | 90 mg twice daily |
| Prasugrel | 60 mg | 10 mg once daily |

elements.text: Patients on DAPT should be assessed for bleeding risk using a validated score before therapy is initiated, and again at each follow-up visit.
